part_a_landslide_event_datasets.dataset_name: COOLR (Cooperative Open Online Landslide Repository) - Landslide Points / Polygons layers
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.organization: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center / NCCS
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.verification_note: Directly fetched the live ArcGIS REST schema for the Landslide_Polygons layer and confirmed real fields including event_date, latitude, longitude, landslide_trigger, admin_division_name, event_import_source. Also confirmed via an independent third-party analysis citing COOLR: 1,735 India events (2000-2020) with verified coordinates, 13.4% of the global total.
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.all_8_ner_states_covered: NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED - country-level India coverage (1,735 events) is confirmed real; a live spatial query filtered to the 8 NER states' bounding box was attempted in this session but blocked by this assistant's own tool permissions (not a limitation of the data source itself). This is a concrete, low-effort next step - the REST API is public and documented to support geometry-filtered queries.
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.event_count: 1,735 for all of India (2000-2020), per third-party analysis. NER-specific subset count: NOT YET DETERMINED.
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.date_range: GLC component: since 2007. Citizen-science (Landslide Reporter) component: since March 2018. Combined catalog spans wider via merged external inventories.
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.event_location_type: Both point and polygon representations exist (Landslide_Points and Landslide_Polygons layers)
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.event_type_field: landslide_category (landslide, mudslide, debris_flow, etc.) and landslide_trigger (rain, downpour, continuous_rain, etc.)
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.api_availability: ArcGIS REST API, confirmed live, supports advanced queries, statistics, spatial filtering, pagination - no authentication wall observed in this session
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.access_restrictions: None observed for basic query/download access
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.license_restrictions: Open/citable - specific citation required per sub-source (GLC citation vs. Landslide Reporter citation vs. individual merged-inventory citations, as documented on the official page)
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.update_frequency: Ongoing (citizen science submissions continue; GLC historically compiled through ~2017 in its original form, COOLR continues to merge new sources)
part_a_landslide_event_datasets.realistic_for_ml_training: YES for event presence/date/location. Caveat: citizen-science and media-report-based records carry inherent reporting bias (events near roads/population more likely reported than remote slope failures) - a real limitation to document, not a reason to discard.
limitations: Reporting bias toward accessible/populated areas
NER-specific event count not yet confirmed - requires a follow-up spatial query
Location accuracy varies by record (an explicit 'location_accuracy' field exists: exact / within 1km / within 5km / etc. - must be used to filter for ML-quality precision)

part_e_existing_gpkg_assessment.can_the_existing_gpkg_be_reused_for_the_: NO, not for the event-date-linked part.
part_e_existing_gpkg_assessment.reasoning: Per Phase 3's methodology audit (already completed and authoritative - re-read, not re-derived here): the 124,553 rows are slope-unit polygons with a STATIC binary presence/absence label (y), not individual dated events. The audit explicitly found no verified date field in the inspected layers. The GeoPackage can supply STATIC terrain/environmental predisposing features (elevation, slope, lithology, etc. - already used in the static model), but cannot supply the DATED landslide occurrences the dynamic model fundamentally requires.
part_e_existing_gpkg_assessment.what_can_be_reused: Static terrain/environmental covariates (per Phase 5B's audit) for the LOCATIONS of known landslide-containing slope units COULD inform spatial context for a dynamic model, but not the temporal/event-date dimension, which must come from Part A's sources instead.

feasibility_reasoning: Real, verified, dated, coordinate-level landslide event data for India/NER DOES exist and is accessible without cost (COOLR, confirmed 1,735 real India events with a live-verified field schema and API). Real historical rainfall at a resolution suitable for event-triggering analysis also exists and is accessible (IMERG, CHIRPS - the latter with zero registration friction). What is NOT yet confirmed: (1) the exact NER-specific subset of COOLR's event count (blocked by this session's own tool limits, not a real data-access barrier - trivially resolvable with a live query), (2) whether NESAC's more geographically-precise NER inventory is machine-readable or PDF-only, (3) soil moisture before 2015 is reanalysis-only (SMAP's real gap), not satellite-observed. None of these are fatal - they are concrete, scoped follow-up actions, not fundamental blockers.
recommended_next_step: Run a live, geometry-filtered query against the COOLR REST API (https://maps.nccs.nasa.gov/mapping/rest/services/landslide_viewer/Landslide_Points/MapServer/0/query) with a bounding box covering the 8 NER states, to get the real NER-specific event count and confirm date/coordinate completeness, before any dataset construction begins.
